label: Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B
description: Reference-image identity + motion copied from the driving clip using VACE control. Much lighter than 14B models, so it is the safe default on a free Colab T4.
notes: Runs fully in ~8-10 GB VRAM with fp16 + ComfyUI lowvram. A 4 s 480p clip takes roughly 2-6 min on a T4 depending on steps.
